title: Lumen Drift validation

checks.name: File count and groups
checks.detail: Exactly 50 MIDI files, 10 in each of the five groups, IDs 001-050.

checks.name: Format and resolution
checks.detail: Each file parses as Standard MIDI Format 0, one track, 480 ticks per quarter.

checks.name: Tempo and time signature
checks.detail: Track name, tempo, and 4/4 time signature are at tick 0. No program change, pitch bend, or controller.

checks.name: Note pairing
checks.detail: Every note-on has one note-off. No unmatched note-off. Note-offs are ordered before note-ons at the same tick.

checks.name: End of track
checks.detail: End of track is the only terminal meta, at the declared loop length, after any note-offs on that tick.

checks.name: Pitch, velocity, and bounds
checks.detail: Pitches are inside 36-96, velocities are 1-127, durations are positive, and no note crosses the loop.

checks.name: Overlap and polyphony
checks.detail: The same MIDI pitch is never active twice. Active notes never exceed 12.

checks.name: Note CSV equality
checks.detail: Parsed notes match the note CSV in pitch, tick, duration, and velocity.

checks.name: Beat rounding
checks.detail: Beat columns match ticks / 480 within 0.0000000005 beats.

checks.name: Tempo encoding
checks.detail: Tempo meta matches the index and the half-up rounding of 60,000,000 / BPM. Every integer from 70 through 115 round-trips.

checks.name: Harmonic partitions
checks.detail: Each loop has 2 to 8 harmonic events whose tick intervals partition the loop.

checks.name: Pitch collections
checks.detail: Sounding pitch classes outside the named collection match the index. Aeolian is the only name used for natural minor.

checks.name: Chord symbols
checks.detail: Chord-symbol intervals are present in the intended voicing. Omissions are written into the symbol.

checks.name: Roman numerals
checks.detail: Roman numeral case matches chord quality, measured from the parallel major.

checks.name: Duplicate detection
checks.detail: No exact copy, no constant transposition, and no unchanged shorter loop repeated inside a longer file.

limitations: The loops were not auditioned. The browser synth is a preview, not a hearing test.
Whether a borrowed chord feels nostalgic is a reading of the voicing ledger, not a scored classifier.
A DAW was not asked to cycle the files. Loop length is in the index because a DAW will not infer it.
The digest covers the MIDI files and the three CSV tables. It does not cover this report or the zip.
